summary: Candidate repairs the V3-08 trusted finalizer failure (run 35530222887) with a stuck-app detector in scripts/e2e-android.js: after STUCK_APP_THRESHOLD consecutive successful-but-empty UI dumps, force-stop + relaunch the app. Trusted verification passed (exit 0: typecheck, 449 tests/22 suites, privacy 71, cost 21, expo export/prebuild, assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL). Independent review found a critical must-fix: the detector increments consecutiveEmptyMatchCount on dump-CACHE hits (no dump ran), so the threshold of 4 is reached in ~1.5-2 s of cache hits after any single non-matching dump, force-stopping a healthy app during normal cold start / screen transitions — exactly the slow-emulator scenarios the previous repairs were designed to handle. A loop simulation of the candidate logic confirmed 3 unnecessary force-stops during a normal 120 s cold start. This would break the golden path E2E that the trusted finalizer runs (step 7), i.e. the very failure this repair targets. The new contract test only asserts static strings and passes with the buggy implementation (weak test). package.json removes unused react-native-view-shot/react-native-worklets direct deps but leaves package-lock.json stale (npm ci tolerates extra lock entries — verified empirically, not a blocker). Decision: repair — keep the coherent delta as WIP baseline; next cycle must guard the counter increment on real dumps only (cache-miss) and strengthen the test to assert that guard.

findings.problem: Stuck-app detector false-positives on dump-cache hits: consecutiveEmptyMatchCount increments whenever dumpFailures <= previousDumpFailures, which is also true when findNodes() returns from the 30 s dump cache without running any dump. After any single non-matching dump, the 500 ms loop sleep reaches STUCK_APP_THRESHOLD=4 in ~1.5-2 s of cache hits and force-stops + relaunches a healthy app that is merely mid-cold-start or mid-screen-transition. This breaks the golden path E2E the trusted finalizer runs (step 7): waitFor('Demarrer', 600000) with a splash-screen warm-up cache force-stops the app ~2 s after the wait starts and repeats, so the app never finishes cold start; waitFor('Appartement', 120000) after tapping Demarrer force-stops the app ~2 s after the first pre-transition dump, killing it mid-sign-in. Simulation of the exact loop logic confirmed 3 false-positive force-stops during a normal 120 s cold start (t=1.5 s, 60 s, 118.5 s).
findings.evidence: waitFor() lines 415-437: `if (dumpFailures <= previousDumpFailures) { consecutiveEmptyMatchCount += 1; if (consecutiveEmptyMatchCount >= STUCK_APP_THRESHOLD) { ... force-stop ... } }` — dumpUi() returns the cached result without touching dumpFailures on cache hits (lines 172-175), so cache hits satisfy the condition. Simulation output: 'APP STUCK at t=1.5s (4 empty matches) — force-stop + relaunch' x3 during a 120 s splash.
findings.requiredFix: Increment consecutiveEmptyMatchCount only when a REAL dump ran (cache miss) and returned no matching node. Concretely: expose a fromCache flag from dumpUi() (or compare _dumpCacheTime before/after the findNodes call) and guard the increment on the dump actually having executed; cache hits must neither increment nor reset the counter. Keep the force-stop + relaunch recovery and the counter resets on crash/dump-failure/stuck recovery.
findings.verification: Re-run the loop simulation with the fix: a 120 s cold start must complete with 0 force-stops; a genuinely stuck app (alive process, valid dumps, no target node for >4 real dumps) must still trigger exactly one force-stop + relaunch. Full trusted verification must stay exit 0.

findings.problem: The new test 'waitFor detects stuck app (alive but no matching nodes) and force-relaunches' is a weak static-contract test: it only asserts the presence of strings ('APP STUCK', 'consecutiveEmptyMatchCount', 'STUCK_APP_THRESHOLD', force-stop, monkey, counter reset). It passes (19/19) with the buggy implementation and therefore gives false confidence that the repair is correct; it does not guard the actual detector logic (increment only on real dumps, not cache hits).
findings.evidence: Test diff lines 240-257 assert only string containment/regex presence; npx jest __tests__/domain/v3-08-finalizer-wrapper.test.ts passes 19/19 while the loop simulation of the same script shows the false-positive force-stop behavior.
findings.requiredFix: Strengthen the contract test to assert the cache-miss guard: e.g. assert dumpUi() returns a fromCache flag (or equivalent) and that the consecutiveEmptyMatchCount increment is conditioned on a real dump having run (cache miss). Reverting the guard must fail the test.
findings.verification: Test suite must fail when the increment guard is removed and pass when the guard is present; full trusted verification stays exit 0.
